summary:
Main
Iron ore futures and seaborne quotes firmed notably today, while most Qingdao port spot products posted modest gains.DCE most-traded closed at 663.0 yuan/mt, up 0.91% from Nov 25. Seven of the eight Qingdao spot products advanced while one declined: PB Fines, Newman Fines, Mac Fines, BRBF, Newman Lump, SSF and Carajas Fines each rose 3 yuan/wmt, whereas PB Lump edged down 2 yuan to 780 yuan/wmt. Port 61% and 58% indices climbed to 642 and 603 yuan/wmt (each +2 yuan), while the 65% port composite index eased 3 yuan to 792 yuan/wmt.
